real_use_case: Record technical QC observations available in a validated single-sample VCF without inferring absent coverage or clinical meaning.
license: Independent project implementation; no third-party implementation or fixture bytes copied.
supported_profile: Output of vcf-intake-envelope for VCF 4.5 text, UTF-8, exactly one sample, uncompressed bytes.
resource_budget: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary memory for decoded text and observations; no network or subprocess.
known_issues: Variant-only VCF cannot establish whole-genome/exome callability or missing-position coverage; no quality thresholds, reference concordance, normalization, classification, interpretation, or full general FORMAT grammar validation beyond the observed GT/DP/GQ/AD checks.
security: Pure bytes processing with no filesystem, network, or subprocess access.
disable_path: Not wired to any default execution pipeline.
